notes.title: Fullscreen & Resolution Bug Fix
notes.notes:
We’ve just released a patch that fixes issues related to fullscreen mode and screen resolution settings. The game should now launch and switch display modes more reliably, with proper support for various screen sizes.

Thanks to everyone who reported these problems — your input is super helpful! If anything still seems off, don’t hesitate to reach out.

notes.title: Update: Correct Bara Cards Uploaded!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We just uploaded the correct version of the bara cards! 
Our apologies — the previous files were mistakenly the unedited versions and were not meant to be included in the game.

Everything should be working fine now, but if you run into any issues, feel free to let us know!

notes.title: Update - Audio Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

In this update, we’ve fixed an issue with the Mute button and the volume sliders in the game’s options. Audio controls should now work properly for a better experience!

A huge thanks to Winter for reporting this bug! 

Keep sending us your feedback—it’s essential for making the game even better.
